verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit connects through GitHub and GitLab accounts and claims setup in about 2 minutes. Its docs say it reviews pull requests within moments of opening and posts actionable inline comments directly on code lines. Community users confirm it reviews their GitHub PRs and describe it as running as a GitHub App. missing for 10: explicit evidence of GitLab merge-request inline comments and independent corroboration of the minutes-level turnaround.

support.subject: As a developer, the reviewer installs as a GitHub/GitLab app and posts reviews as native inline comments on my pull requests within minutes

citations.quote: Use your existing GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket Cloud, or Bitbucket Data Center account to create your CodeRabbit account.
Get CodeRabbit up and running in 2 minutes. Connect your repositories and start receiving AI-powered code reviews
Within moments of opening a pull request, CodeRabbit analyzes your code with multiple AI models and provides actionable feedback
CodeRabbit requests changes when a review posts actionable inline comments
posts inline comments with suggested fixes — directly on the lines of code that caused the failure
It is able to catch bugs that even claude code misses on our Github PRs.
